import os

class NexusControlPanelApp:

        self.lbl_status = tk.Label(status_card, text='● OFFLINE / STOPPED', font=('Segoe UI', 11, 'bold'), fg='#F43F5E', bg='#1E293B')

        self.btn_start.pack(side='left', expand=True, fill='x', padx=(0, 10))

        btn_voice.pack(side='left', expand=True, fill='x', padx=2)

        self.log_area.pack(fill='both', expand=True, padx=20, pady=(0, 15))
        self.log_message('Nexus-226 Master Control Panel initialized.')

    def log_message(self, msg: str):
        ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        self.log_area.insert('end', f'[{ts}] {msg}\n')
        self.log_area.see('end')

    def _check_initial_status(self):
        cmd = 'powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8501 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"'
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if 'Listen' in res.stdout or 'Established' in res.stdout:
            self.is_running = True
            self.lbl_status.config(text='● ONLINE / RUNNING (Port 8501)', fg='#10B981')
            self.log_message('Detected existing server running on port 8501.')
        else:
            self.is_running = False
            self.lbl_status.config(text='● OFFLINE / STOPPED', fg='#F43F5E')

    def start_system(self):
        if self.is_running:
            self.log_message('System is already running on port 8501.')
            self.open_browser()
            return
        self.log_message('Initiating Nexus-226 Streamlit engine...')
        self.lbl_status.config(text='● STARTING...', fg='#FBBF24')
        self.root.update()

        def _runner():
            script_path = os.path.join(root_dir, 'web_ui.py')
            cmd = [sys.executable, '-m', 'streamlit', 'run', script_path, '--server.port', '8501', '--server.headless', 'true']
            self.server_process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=root_dir, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == 'nt' else 0)
            time.sleep(2)
            self.is_running = True
            self.lbl_status.config(text='● ONLINE / RUNNING (Port 8501)', fg='#10B981')
            self.log_message('Nexus-226 Online: Web Cockpit accessible at http://localhost:8501')
            webbrowser.open('http://localhost:8501')
        threading.Thread(target=_runner, daemon=True).start()

    def stop_system(self):
        self.log_message('Stopping Nexus-226 processes...')
        self.lbl_status.config(text='● STOPPING...', fg='#FBBF24')
        self.root.update()
        kill_cmd = 'powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8501 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"'
        subprocess.run(kill_cmd, shell=True)
        if self.server_process:
            try:
                self.server_process.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.server_process = None
        time.sleep(1)
        self.is_running = False
        self.lbl_status.config(text='● OFFLINE / STOPPED', fg='#F43F5E')
        self.log_message('Nexus-226 stopped. All connections closed.')

    def open_browser(self):
        if not self.is_running:
            self.log_message("Warning: System is offline. Click 'START SYSTEM' first.")
        webbrowser.open('http://localhost:8501')

    def start_voice_call(self):
        self.log_message('Launching Always-On Voice Call Console in dedicated window...')
        call_cmd = f'start cmd /k "{sys.executable} main.py --mode voice"'
        subprocess.run(call_cmd, shell=True, cwd=root_dir)

    def check_telemetry(self):
        from core.system_controller import SystemController
        sc = SystemController()
        t = sc.get_telemetry()
        self.log_message(f"Telemetry: CPU={t['cpu_usage_percent']}% | RAM Free={t['ram_available_gb']}GB/{t['ram_total_gb']}GB ({t['ram_used_percent']}%) | Battery={t['battery']['percent']}%")

def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = NexusControlPanelApp(root)
    root.mainloop()
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import sys
import os
import argparse
import subprocess
root_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if root_dir not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, root_dir)
from core.agent import Nexus226Agent
from core.voice_loop import ConversationalCallLoop

def run_text_loop(agent: Nexus226Agent):
    print('\n' + '=' * 65)
    print(' [NEXUS-226] AUTONOMOUS OFFLINE AI (TEXT TERMINAL)')
    print(' 226 AI Paradigms | Machine Control | Blockchain Transactions')
    print(" Type 'exit' or 'quit' to terminate session.")
    print('=' * 65 + '\n')
    while True:
        try:
            query = input('\n[Nexus-226 User] >> ')
            if not query.strip():
                continue
            if query.strip().lower() in ['exit', 'quit', 'shutdown']:
                print('Terminating Nexus-226 session.')
                break
            response = agent.process_request(query)
            print(f'\n[Nexus-226 AI]:\n{response}')
        except (KeyboardInterrupt, EOFError):
            print('\nSession interrupted. Exiting.')
            break

def run_voice_loop(agent: Nexus226Agent):
    call = ConversationalCallLoop(agent_responder=agent.process_request)
    call.start_call()

def run_gui():
    print('[Nexus-226] Launching Streamlit Web Cockpit...')
    script_path = os.path.join(root_dir, 'web_ui.py')
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'streamlit', 'run', script_path])

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Nexus-226: Autonomous Offline AI Agent')
    parser.add_argument('--mode', choices=['voice', 'text', 'gui'], default='voice', help='Operating mode: voice (Always-On Call), text (CLI), or gui (Streamlit Cockpit)')
    parser.add_argument('query', nargs='*', help='Optional single-shot query/command to run immediately')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.query:
        agent = Nexus226Agent()
        full_query = ' '.join(args.query)
        result = agent.process_request(full_query)
        print(result)
        return
    if args.mode == 'gui':
        run_gui()
    elif args.mode == 'text':
        agent = Nexus226Agent()
        run_text_loop(agent)
    else:
        agent = Nexus226Agent()
        run_voice_loop(agent)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
